name: Cultural Revolution in China
short_desc: Mao Zedong’s political campaign brings purges, mass persecution and severe disruption to Chinese society.
date_note: The conventional 1966–1976 period covers a political and social campaign with violent phases.
notes: Added after a catalog gap review on 24 October 2026. A distinct large-scale political and social upheaval missing despite an existing Great Leap Forward record. Evidence and date rationale: The conventional 1966–1976 period follows the National Archives and Smithsonian chronology. This is a state-initiated political and social campaign with violent phases, rather than a separate interstate war merely because its name contains revolution. Primary evidence: https://www.nationalarchives.gov.uk/education/resources/the-cultural-revolution/. Cached Wikipedia introduction and lead image provide separately attributed background. Remains review, not comprehensive factual approval.
